approval_source: User instruction: Experiment B Sampling-Frame Amendment
prospective_rule: Official annual-conference main research proceedings: a sole main representation, or both separately represented long and short research volumes. Stop for mixed, incomplete, duplicate or ambiguous structures.
volume_identity_rule: Keep long and short as distinct source volume identities; neither is an alias for main.
sampling_rule: Pool the explicitly included research volumes within each conference year before applying the unchanged deterministic two-record ACL panel ranking.
